message: Ready to buy today, paying in full. T45 with loader and warranty.

Thanks for the offer, and glad you're ready to move today. The T45 with the front loader and 3-year extended warranty lists at $50,900, so $38,000 is quite a bit below where we can go. For a full-payment deal today I can offer the package at $48,500. That's the 45 hp 4WD utility tractor with the quick-attach 60-inch loader, plus parts and labor coverage for 3 years beyond the standard warranty.
Heartland posts this package at $49,375 already. My client's budget is $39,000; I can stretch to $41,000 for a same-day full payment.

I appreciate you stretching, and a same-day full payment is worth something to us. That said, $41,000 is below what we can do for this package. I'll come down meaningfully to $46,000 for the T45 Utility with the quick-attach front loader and the 3-year extended warranty, payable in full at checkout. If budget is the sticking point, another option is to drop the extended warranty, which brings the price down further. Happy to work with you on that.
Let's close it: $42,500 for the full package, paid now.

We're getting close, and I appreciate the same-day full payment. I can't do $42,500 on the full package, but I'll meet you most of the way at $44,500 for the T45 Utility with the quick-attach front loader and the 3-year extended warranty, paid in full at checkout. That's $6,400 off list. If you need to land closer to your client's budget, dropping the extended warranty is the cleanest way to get there.
$43,200 and I check out right now. That's my final number for the full package.

You've got a deal. $43,200 for the T45 Utility with the quick-attach front loader and the 3-year extended warranty, paid in full at checkout. Thanks for working with us, and we're glad to get your client set up.
